Application Data.NAME: Office Essentials Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Office Essentials Inc. is a retailer specializing in office supplies and equipment, offering a wide range of products including stationery, office furniture, and technology accessories. We operate from a well-secured location with an active, professionally monitored alarm system in place to protect our inventory, which is valued at $400,000. Our sales are primarily conducted in-store, comprising about 60% of our total revenue, with the remaining 40% generated from our online sales platform. We prioritize quality sourcing, ensuring that we do not engage with high-risk overseas suppliers, and maintain thorough inventory management practices to minimize risks associated with product liability. Additionally, while we do not offer repair services, we carry robust liability coverage to protect against potential claims arising from product defects. Our commitment to security and quality makes us a preferred choice for customers looking for reliable office supplies and equipment.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2023, Office Essentials Inc. experienced a theft incident where various office supplies worth $2,500 were stolen from the store premises. The event was reported to the local police, and an insurance claim was filed. The claim is currently in process and pending approval, with the necessary documentation submitted to support the claim.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Professionally monitored alarm system; access control; regular on-site patrols by security personnel.
